# For sale luxurious large-scale 3-bedroom apartment, River Park, Old Town, Bratislava

> RE/MAX exclusively offers for sale a luxurious large-scale 3-bedroom apartment in Bratislava's Old Town in the well-known River Park residential project on the banks of the Danube that was never inhabited. The apartment on the tenth floor out of twelve has a usable area of 184.13 m² plus two terraces with a total area of another 33.82 m².

## Fakta
- Typ: byt
- Druh nabídky: predaj
- Dispozice: 4-izbový
- Plocha: 218 m²
- Podlaží: 10
- Stav: Novostavba
- Vlastnictví: Osobné
- Lokalita: Dvořakovo nábrežie, Staré Mesto, Bratislava
- Cena: cena na vyžiadanie
